items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: the guy offered me a job with Billie Holiday -- a little club on the north side; a trio -- she had a piano player, Carl Drinkard

ctx.x: The strip joints . See, everybody at one time worked out there. Vernell was working down the street, Ike had in fact, he showed me how to play one lady's act -- a lady called Tanalia -- she worked with snakes -- a mystic type thing, alligator -- we had 5 pieces out there. And the guy that had the bag was called Jive Jackson, a trumpet player -- bless his soul. Jive had the bag. He didn't have nothing but junkies in his band, all except the tenor player -- he didn't fool around.

But the piano player, myself, Jive -- well, he was the leader; he had the bag. Now, he was selling pills and would give us each 2 pills before we go to work and 2 pills when we got off work, and made sure he paid our rent -- we didn't have no pocket change to buy some cigarettes or anything -- and we were happy.
